PAGE 03
Apni pehli sवारी — Mumbai ki galiyon mein

"Aunty se kehna ke galat kehte hai log — pyaar se pet nahi bharta.
Unke pyaar se banayi rotiyon ne mera jeevan khushiyon se bhar diya.

Socha nahi tha ke pahado ke paar koi aisa milega
jo kuch pal mein ruh ko poora chhu lega.
Ghar mein hum do hi the toh bhi bhara lagta tha —
ab do ho toh bhi tere bina sab adhura lagta hai.

Dhruv se kehna — ek Mahek toh hum le jayenge,
par vaada, doosri jaldi hi layenge."

॥ MUMBAI ॥

A letter I couldn't say out loud
Meri Mahek, Papa se kehna — do birthday aur, phir ek naya mehmaan aayega… kaabil ho ke aapki seedhiyon pe aauunga. Jaldi hi papa se milna chahunga. Saath tera ho toh chaand bhi feeka hai…
jeevan mein tu nahi toh jeevan hi feeka hai. — tera Ansh ❤
❤
TAP THE ENVELOPE TO OPEN ❤

"Aur uske baare mein kya likhu — pyaar ki paribhasha ka deedar hai woh.
Main toh bas ek aawara… ek chamatkaar hai woh.
Hote nahi log aksar uske jaise —
sochta hun, usne itna khoobsurat banaya isko kaise.

Aankhon mein savera hai, pyaar ka wahi basera hai,
jeevan ki behti dhaara hai woh, mere pyaar ka sahara hai woh.
Masoomiyat chhalakti hai jiske palko se,
pyaar ki tarang jiski aawaz se —
aisi kaaya ko kaise do shabdo mein bayaan karu?

Bas itna hi keh sakuunga —
saath tera ho toh chaand bhi feeka hai…
jeevan mein tu nahi toh jeevan hi feeka hai."

Happy Birthday, meri jaan
MAHEK

— tera, hamesha ke liye ❤
